name: Rapariegos (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of red, yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Rapariegos (a castle on blue and a bend and wheat on white).
history: The flag of Rapariegos was published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 8 April 1998 and the arms and flag were approved officially on 13 May 2005; the flag is a square cloth of proportion 1:1 divided horizontally into three equal parts, red above, yellow in the centre and blue below, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Rapariegos arms — castle on blue, bend and wheat on white
